name: green-custom-or-stdv-extended
note: Custom OR + STDV, extended levels ON (M10). The base fixture green-custom-or-stdv runs with showExtSTDV at its default of false, so the eight extended outputs draw nothing there - without THIS fixture they would exist in the source and be asserted by nothing. Prices are hand-computed from orbHigh=112, orbLow=90, orRange=22; -4.5 STDV is legitimately negative (90 - 99 = -9) on this synthetic dataset and is not a bug.
